title: HtmlInputPassword
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type password without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputPassword.children
inputs.description: Optional Snippet that the component destructures out of its props, so it is kept out of the forwarded attributes. The markup never renders it, so passing a snippet has no effect and the input renders no child content.

outputs.name: HtmlInputPassword
outputs.description: The native `input` element that `<svelte:element this={'input'}>` creates, with every forwarded attribute spread onto it and `type` set to `password` after the spread, so any passed `type` is replaced by `password`. No wrapper element is added and no child content is rendered.
